sections.title: Lagging sides
lines: Lagging (150+ behind the leader): Landwehr by Submission, Nallo by Decision, Nallo by Submission.
Landwehr by Submission: 420 behind. Steps to 7c if the crowd trades lower.
Nallo by Decision: 420 behind. Steps to 7c if the crowd trades lower.

sections.title: Next wave of contracts
lines: Full ladder posts Sat 9:00am CT: 1,575 more contracts across 6 buckets.
A bucket gets a new batch when its resting drops under 25% of its allotment.
Gate closed: batches wait for the worst line to reach -$100 (now -$235).

sections.title: Tightening
lines: Backstop ON: Nallo by KO/TKO stopped adding until worst line is above -$225.
Paid balancing starts Sat 5:00pm CT: worst line to -$100, up to $100.
Even-up Sat 6:30pm CT; last-resort take Sat 6:55pm CT; handoff to the fight Sat 6:57pm CT.
The fight start is an estimate and can move.

sections.title: Will it adapt on its own?
lines: Mostly yes: the full ladder, extra batches, price steps and paid balancing run by rule. The start time can shift.
